rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an item bought at an unusually good price.

example.english: This is a real bargain—it’s much cheaper than elsewhere.
example.traditional: 呢件真係筍嘢，抵到不得了。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 zan1 hai6 seon2 je5 dai2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for negotiating a price or haggling.

example.english: I bargain with the shop assistant to get it cheaper.
example.traditional: 我同個店員講價，想買平啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 go3 dim3 jyun4 gong2 gaa3 soeng2 maai5 peng4 di1

rows.note: Use this when specifically trying to push the price down, usually as a buyer.

example.english: This shirt is too expensive, so I need to bargain the price down with them.
example.traditional: 呢件衫太貴喇，我要同佢殺價。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 taai3 gwai3 laa3 ngo5 jiu3 tung4 keoi5 saat3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when negotiation results in settling the matter or reaching a deal rather than merely discussing the price.

example.english: We managed to bargain over the lease and reach a deal, so we can sign now.
example.traditional: 個租約我哋已經傾掂，可以簽喇。
example.jyutping: go3 zou1 joek3 ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 king1 dim6 ho2 ji5 cim1 laa3
